title: Transom Capital Completes Acquisition of SoundThinking
summary: SoundThinking delivers public safety technology and services — including the ShotSpotter gunshot detection system — that help law enforcement and communities respond faster and save lives.
body_markdown:
**Los Angeles, California and Fremont, California** , **November 18, 2026** ― Transom Capital Group, LLC (together with its affiliates, “Transom”), an operationally focused middle-market private equity firm, and SoundThinking, Inc. (“SoundThinking” or the “Company”), a leading public safety technology company, today announced the completion of Transom’s previously announced acquisition of SoundThinking.


The transaction marks a new chapter for SoundThinking as a privately held company, providing an opportunity to further advance its public safety technology solutions and expand its impact across the communities it serves.


“SoundThinking has built a differentiated platform in public safety technology, with solutions that play a critical role in helping law enforcement agencies better serve their communities,” said Mads Jorge, Managing Director at Transom. “We see a significant opportunity to leverage our operational expertise to strengthen commercial execution and accelerate growth, including through strategic M&A. Our priority is to work alongside management to build on SoundThinking’s innovation and longstanding customer relationships as we pursue the next phase of growth.”


“We are excited to begin this new chapter for SoundThinking in partnership with Transom,” said Ralph Clark, President and CEO of SoundThinking. “We have made significant progress supporting cities and their respective law enforcement agencies and community partners across the country in delivering stronger public safety outcomes for the people they serve, and we look forward to building on that work. Transom’s belief in our purpose and our team makes them the right partner for SoundThinking as we continue to deliver on our mission of helping more communities become safer and more resilient through data and technology.”


**Completion of Tender Offer and Transaction Details**


Transom’s tender offer (the “Offer”) to acquire all issued and outstanding shares (“Shares”) of SoundThinking’s common stock in exchange for (i) $8.00 per Share, net to the stockholder in cash, without interest, plus (ii) one non-transferable contingent value right (“CVR”) per Share, which represents the contractual right to receive a contingent cash payment of up to $3.00 per CVR, without interest and less any applicable tax withholding, upon the achievement of certain revenue milestones (together, the “Offer Price”), expired as scheduled at one minute after 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on November 17, 2026 (such date and time, the “Expiration Time”).


Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, the depositary for the Offer, confirmed to Transom that 9,225,095 Shares were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn in the Offer, representing approximately 69.5% of the issued and outstanding Shares as of the Expiration Time. All conditions to the Offer have been satisfied. Accordingly, Transom has accepted for payment all Shares validly tendered and not validly withdrawn pursuant to the Offer, and will promptly pay for such Shares.


Following its acceptance for payment of the tendered Shares, Transom completed its acquisition of SoundThinking through a statutory merger under Section 251(h) of the Delaware General Corporation Law on November 18, 2026, with SoundThinking continuing as the surviving corporation and becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Transom. All remaining Shares that were not validly tendered in the Offer were converted into the right to receive the same Offer Price that would have been paid had such Shares been validly tendered in the Offer. As of November 18, 2026, SoundThinking’s common stock will no longer be listed or traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market.


Kirkland & Ellis LLP served as legal advisor to Transom. Tidal Partners LLC served as financial advisor and Cooley LLP served as legal advisor to SoundThinking.


**About Transom Capital**


Transom is a leading operationally focused private equity firm that thrives in complexity, specializing in identifying and unlocking value in the middle market. Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Los Angeles, Transom has established a strong track record across various economic cycles by employing a time-tested, operationally intensive strategy to drive transformative outcomes. Transom’s expertise spans corporate carve-outs, lender-owned businesses, undervalued public companies, and other complex situations requiring speed, flexibility, and precision. Supported by a large in-house operations team, Transom delivers tailored solutions backed with functional expertise to help companies unlock their full potential.


Transom’s sector-flexible approach is grounded in pattern recognition, value creation, and disciplined execution. The firm provides not only capital, but also the tools, insights, and operational capabilities necessary to accelerate business performance and create long-term value.


For more information, visit www.transomcap.com


.


**About SoundThinking**


SoundThinking, Inc. is a leading public safety technology company that delivers AI- and data-driven solutions for law enforcement, civic leadership, and security professionals. SoundThinking is trusted by approximately 300 customers and supports approximately 2,100 agencies to drive more efficient, effective, and equitable public safety outcomes. The company’s SafetySmart™ platform includes ShotSpotter®, the leading acoustic gunshot detection system; CrimeTracer™, the leading law enforcement search engine; SafePointe®, an AI-based weapons detection system; PlateRanger™ (powered by Rekor®), a leading ALPR solution; and Field Agent™, an AI layer that transforms public safety data into actionable intelligence. SoundThinking has been designated a Great Place to Work® Company.
